name: RSDKv3
description:
RSDKv3 is a full, open-source standalone decompilation of Sonic CD (2011) and the Retro Engine v3. It brings the definitive remaster of Sonic CD natively to Linux with silky-smooth performance and native widescreen rendering.

Features:
- Native 60 FPS gameplay eliminating mobile and console emulation overhead
- True widescreen display rendering with scalable menus and HUD elements
- Play as Sonic, Tails, and Knuckles with their respective abilities
- Includes both Original Japanese and US soundtrack arrangements
- Modern gamepad support with remappable controls and rumble feedback
